title: Spatial Js First Runtime
description: Implement @spatial/js-core, @spatial/js-kernel-brepjs, @spatial/js-renderer-r3f with schemas, fixtures, factory runtime, brepjs kernel, R3F play demo. MCP repo server unavailable in agent environment; ticket opened manually.
summary: Fixed spatial brepjs/OpenCascade wasm loading by initializing brepjs-opencascade explicitly with a Vite-resolved wasm URL via locateFile, preventing Vite optimized dependency paths from falling back to index.html. Verified kernel tests, R3F production build, raw dev-server wasm MIME/magic bytes, and browser-side BrepjsKernel createBox volume through Vite.
